You look a little lost, as though you're not sure where to go or what to do first.
That's right. I'm not sure where I should go.
strings.그러시군요. 그렇다면 제가 딱 필요한 타이밍이네요!: I see. Then you've met me at just the right time!
I'm Ases, an instructor with the Adventurer Association. We help adventurers like you on their journeys.
Now, how can I help...? Ah, follow me.
Before you set off, I think you should get some hunting practice.
strings.그렇긴 하지만…, 그런데 어디로 가죠?: That makes sense... But where are we going?
strings.벨로스 인근에 산림지대가 있어요. 그곳에서 제가 초보 모험가분들의 사냥을: There's a Forest Area near Belos. I help new adventurers practice hunting there.
Even people who know their way around a fight can get flustered when they actually head out.
I'll go ahead and wait for you. Gather what you need, then come when you're ready.
strings.산림지대로 가는 길은 마을 안쪽으로 가다 보면 있으니 찾는 건 어렵지 않: You'll find the path to the Forest Area farther into the village. It shouldn't be hard to find.
strings.오시는 길이 불편하지 않으셨나요?: Did you have any trouble getting here?
strings.(저쪽에서 이상한 기분이 드네….): (I'm getting a strange feeling from over there...)
strings.저쪽이 궁금하신가 보군요. 저기는 오래된 나무들이 숲을 이루는 고목나무: Curious about that place? That's the Ancient Forest, a woodland of very old trees. You'll have to pass through it to get to Elias.
strings.오면서 봤는데 모험가님의 실력이 생각보다 괜찮은 것 같아요. 제가 더: I watched you on the way here. You're better than I expected—good enough that you hardly need any more instruction from me.
With your skills, you could leave this place and head elsewhere right away.
Thank you. That's kind of you to say.
strings.뭘요. 그러면 엘리아스로 바로 가셔도 되고, 이곳에서 조금 더 훈련하셔도: You're welcome. You can head straight to Elias, or stay here and train a little longer.
All right. I'll take a look around, then head to the Ancient Forest.
Something's come up, so I'm going to the Temple of Pluton.
Perhaps we'll run into each other again on your way to Elias.
strings.(저기가 고목나무 숲이구나. 쉬었다가 바로 가보자.): (So that's the Ancient Forest. I'll rest for a moment, then head over.)
strings.(고목나무 숲 안쪽에서 %s에게 이상한 느낌이 다가온다. 말로 설명할 수: (Deep inside the Ancient Forest, a strange sensation washes over %s. Something beyond words...)
strings.(저쪽에서 이상한 기분이 들어….): (There's a strange feeling coming from over there...)
According to the sign, this isn't the way to the Temple of Pluton...
I'll try going that way first.
strings.(오래되고 커다란 나무가 시야를 사로잡는다. 그 밑으로 묘한 느낌을 간직: (An enormous, ancient tree catches your eye. Beneath it lies a scroll with a peculiar air about it.)
strings.(저 두루마리가 날 부르고 있는 것 같아…. 대체 뭘까?): (It feels like that scroll is calling to me... What could it be?)
strings.(자연스럽게 두루마리에 손이 간다. 조심스레 들어 펼쳐 보니 꽃이 가득한: (Your hand reaches for the scroll almost of its own accord. You carefully pick it up and unroll it. An ink painting depicts a beautiful valley filled with flowers, its light washes of color both delicate and bright.)
(It is only a painting, yet another world seems to stretch out beyond the scroll.)
strings.(아름다운 꽃밭에 서서 폭포의 물줄기를 바라보고 있는 소녀의 모습이 인상: (A girl stands in a beautiful field of flowers, gazing at a waterfall. The sight is striking.)
(Something about the girl in the painting feels strange. It is almost as if she is moving... Then you hear her voice, as though she is speaking to you.)
strings.(이게 뭐지? 머릿속에서 들려오는 것 같아. 자, 잠깐….): (What's happening? It sounds like it's inside my head. W-wait...)
strings.(엄청난 빛이 두루마리에서 발산된다. 눈이 멀 것만 같은 엄청난 빛에 그: (A tremendous light bursts from the scroll. Blinded by its brilliance, you let the scroll slip from your hands.)
strings.아, 쫌! 두루마리 이리 떨구면 안된 다 캤는데. 어, 오늘 날씨 참 좋: Hey, come on! I told you not to drop the scroll like that. Oh, lovely weather today!
strings.(그림 속의 소녀가 눈앞에 나타나 혼자 떠들고 있다.): (The girl from the painting appears before you, chattering to herself.)
strings.짜잔, 조에 등장! 내 등장하니 반갑재? 오랜만이네…. 엥…? 으갸갹!: Ta-da! Zoe's here! Happy to see me? It's been ages... Huh...? Aaaah!
strings.(소녀가 이쪽을 보더니 놀라 뒤로 물러난다. 그러다 진정이 됐는지 조심스: (The girl looks your way and recoils in surprise. Once she has calmed down, she approaches cautiously and speaks.)
strings.미안합니데이, 내가 아는 사람인 줄 알고. 그런데 무웬, 무웬이 없나?: Sorry about that! I thought you were someone I knew. But Muwen... Is Muwen not here? He isn't...?
strings.그런데 당신은 누고? 아, 내 소개가 늦었데이 내는 조에. 조에라고 한데: So who are you? Oh, where are my manners? I'm Zoe. The name's Zoe!
strings.%s, %s…. 특이한 이름이네. 그런데 어쩌다 여기 왔나? 길 잃었나?: %s, %s... That's an unusual name. How did you end up here? Get lost?
strings.마, 됐다. 내가 한참 연상이지만, 말 편하게 하래이. 그래서 어떻게 왔: Ah, never mind. I may be much older than you, but there's no need to be so formal. Now, how did you say you got here?
strings.(누군가 부르는 느낌에 오다보니 여기까지 오게 됐다고 답한다.): (You explain that you felt someone calling you and followed the feeling all the way here.)
strings.누군가 불렀다고? 에이, 불러서 여기까지 올 일이 아니데이. 길 잃은 게: Someone called you? Oh, come on. You wouldn't wander all the way out here just for that. You must've gotten lost. Unless...
Well, never mind. But what am I doing here?
Um, there's something I'd like to ask...
strings.알았다. 물어보고 싶은 게 뭐고?: All right. What's on your mind?
strings.내는 조에. 아까 말한대로 평범한 꽃의 정령이데이. 또 소개가 필요한가?: I'm Zoe! Like I said, just your ordinary flower spirit. Do I need another introduction? Never seen a flower spirit before?
A spirit? You're a spirit...? No, this is my first time.
strings.에, 진짜 처음 보나?: Huh? You've really never seen one?
strings.신기한 사람이데이. 정령을 처음 보다니…. 그러면 설명을 할 테니 잘 들: What a strange person you are, never having seen a spirit... All right, I'll explain, so listen up.
strings.자연의 모든 것에는 정령이 있꼬, 강한 힘을 가진 정령은 내처럼 실체화할: Everything in nature has a spirit. Powerful spirits can take physical form, like me. And pretty spirits show up looking as lovely as I do!
What, have people been lying to you your whole life? Try believing someone for once!
strings.모란과 장미처럼 화사하고! 아름다운 정령님이 말씀하시는데 실례 아이가!: How rude! You're speaking to a beautiful spirit, as radiant as peonies and roses! Hmph!
strings.마, 알았다. 내가 잘못했다!. 정령 중에 파란 피부에 근육질에 수염: Fine, fine! My mistake! Some spirits are blue-skinned, muscular men with bushy beards—or old fellows, for that matter... (mumble, mumble)
strings.그런데 두루마리엔 왜 있었어?: But why were you in the scroll?
Ah, well. A long time ago, I made a contract with the owner of this scroll...
strings.계약의 내용은 말해줄 수 없데이. 언젠가 기회가 되면 니도 알게 될지도: I can't tell you what's in the contract. Maybe you'll find out someday, if the chance comes. The rest is a secret. A secret!
strings.무웬이 누구냐꼬? 음. 그 아는, 그러니까 무웬이는 동료이자 내가 보호자: Who's Muwen? Hmm. That boy... Well, Muwen's my traveling companion, and I'm his guardian.
That's right. He's still a young lad. Though sometimes he's surprisingly grown-up.
strings.이리스를 따라 여행을 시작했을 때는 평범하고 장난치기 좋아하는 머스마였데: When we first set out with Iris, he was an ordinary boy who loved playing pranks. Now he's grown into a fine adventurer.
His talent for adventure and that pure heart of his... He must get those from his parents, Zenon and Gowen...
You really care about Muwen, don't you?
strings.내 아니면 머스마가 혼자 암것도 못한데이. 바보 같은 건지, 순수한 건지: That boy can't do a thing without me. I don't know whether he's foolish or just innocent. He drives me up the wall!
%s, are you sure you haven't seen Muwen? Maybe he went to the village...
Come to think of it, how did I mistake you for Iris, %s...?
strings.잘 모르겠는데, 어떤 신비한 힘이 느껴졌었데이. 이리스와 좀 비슷한 느낌: I'm not sure, but I felt some mysterious power from you. A little like Iris... Such strong determination, with a hint of loneliness...
strings.됐다. 근데 니! 왠지 이리스랑 만난 적이 있는 것 같은데, 내 착각이: Never mind that. You! I get the feeling you've met Iris before. Am I imagining it? But Iris is definitely... Oh, no. Forget I said anything.
strings.(조에에게 이리스에 대해 알고 있는 것들만 이야기한다.): (You tell Zoe what you know about Iris.)
...Then I suppose you're no ordinary traveler.
What's that? No more questions? All right, then.
strings.그런데, 무슨 생각을 그리 해?: What are you thinking about so hard?
strings.아이다. 그나저나 니가 보기보다 신비로운 면이 좀 있데이?: Nothing. You know, there's more mystery to you than meets the eye.
strings.그카믄 니는 이리스를 만나기 위해 여행을 시작한 걸지도 모른다 카이. 우: Maybe you started this journey so you could meet Iris. Whether that's chance or fate, I couldn't say...
As one of Iris's dear friends, there's something I have to say.
Thank you, truly... Oh, that's not it. I have a favor to ask.
strings.네 여행에 내가 같이 가도 안 되겠나?: Would you let me come along on your journey?
strings.무웬을 찾으러 가야 카는데, 지금 두루마리에서 막 나온지 얼마 안 돼 좀: I need to find Muwen, but I've only just come out of the scroll. I'm still feeling a bit out of sorts.
Take me along, and I can tell you more about Iris.
All right! I'd like to hear more about Iris.
strings.(조에가 말한 무웬이란 아이를 찾을 때까지 함께 가는 것도 괜찮을 것 같: (It might be nice to travel together until we find this boy Muwen she mentioned...)
strings.후후! 그카면 잘 부탁한데이!!: Hehe! Then I'm counting on you!
And I'm counting on you. Let's head to Elias.
strings.오, 엘리아스. 내는 좋데이. 내 길눈이 좋으니 따라 오래이. 쫌 가면: Oh, Elias! Sounds good to me. I've got a great sense of direction, so follow along. We might run into Muwen on the way!
strings.(조에와 함께 엘리아스로 가게 됐다.): (You set off for Elias with Zoe.)
strings.와아~! 날씨 좋고! 경치 좋고! 기운이 좋은 대지 위에 세워진 플루톤: Wow! Lovely weather, lovely scenery! The Temple of Pluton is built on land full of good energy. What a wonderful place!
I think some monsters are running this way...
strings.이곳으로 올려온다고! 피해!!: They're coming straight at us! Get out of the way!
strings.마, 됐다. 신경 쓰지 말그래이. 쟈들은 뛰는 게 일이니…. 어, 저 뒤: Oh, don't worry about them. Running around is what they do... Huh, doesn't it look like someone's chasing them? Are those...?
Are you sure we shouldn't move? I suppose we could watch for now...
strings.(모험가 협회 소속 교관 모자를 쓴 사람 둘이 몬스터들을 뒤쫓다 조에를: (Two people wearing Adventurer Association instructors' caps chase after the monsters. Spotting Zoe, they stop.)
strings.와, 조에? 조에다! 어라, %s도 조에랑 함께네요?: Wow, Zoe? It is you! And %s is with you too?
strings.(조에에게 이그나트라 불린 남자가 반갑게 인사한다.): (The man Zoe called Ignate greets her warmly.)
Zoe, it's been a while. I never expected to see you here.
strings.정말 귀엽고 아름다운 정령이라니까. 이렇게 조에를 보다니 오늘은 운이 좋: Such a cute, beautiful spirit! It must be my lucky day, running into Zoe like this. Oh, where's Muwen?
strings.%s, 들었나? 내보고 귀엽고 아름답다고 하는걸?: %s, did you hear that? Cute and beautiful, that's me!
Ases, Ignate, what are you doing running around the Temple of Pluton? As for Muwen...
It's good to see you again, but this isn't really the best time to catch up.
Sorry. We have something to take care of. We'll see you later.
Ugh, what a mess. Come on, Ignate.
Hahaha. You always keep your cool, Ases. Let's go.
Still not as well as you do.
strings.(이그나트와 아세스가 다시 뛰어가고, 그 뒤로 엘리아스 왕국 병사들로 보: (Ignate and Ases take off again. People who appear to be soldiers from the Kingdom of Elias follow close behind.)
strings.먼 큰일이 나긴 했나 보다. 엘리아스 왕국의 병사들과 함께 하는 걸 보면: Must be quite a problem if they've got soldiers from Elias helping them...
Whew... It is indeed, Miss Zoe.
strings.(조에가 자신을 바라보는 한 청년을 보고 반가워 한다. 학자같은 인상의: (Zoe brightens at the sight of a young man looking her way. He has the air of a scholar. Catching his breath, he looks down the road the soldiers took.)
strings.(땀이 흐르고 지친 기색이 가득한 걸 보니 먼저 간 일행을 따라가다 놓친: (Sweaty and exhausted, he seems to have fallen behind the others.)
strings.야휘! 야휘 씨, 잘 있었나? 여긴 무슨 일인교? 마을에 있어야 할 사람: Yahui! Mr. Yahui, how have you been? What brings you here? Shouldn't you be back in the village?
Miss Zoe, it has been a while. Whew... Something terrible has happened, and I'm afraid it's my fault.
The [Serestia] I was keeping safe has been stolen. I was careless.
Mr. Yahui, how could you lose it? That was... Iris's...
strings.(조에가 슬픈 얼굴로 말을 잇지 못한다.): (Zoe looks so sad that she cannot finish.)
Zoe, let's hear Mr. Yahui out first.
strings.몬스터들이 세레스티아가 가진 힘에 반응해 마을까지 간 거 같습니다. 그래: I believe the monsters sensed Serestia's power and followed it into the village. They attacked without warning and took it...
Whew... That's no toy for a bunch of monsters to play with.
strings.니도 궁금한가 보네. 세레스티아란 활은 데르 족이 만든 무기인데, 어둠을: Curious, are you? Serestia is a bow made by the Tyr people. It has the power to drive away darkness.
strings.바보 같은 몬스터들이 지 맘대로 사용하면 안 되는 물건이라 쓰면 큰일 나: It's not something those foolish monsters can use however they like. If they try, there'll be trouble! Even Iris struggled with it at first, and she's a Tyr...
Exactly. If you have a moment to spare...
%s, I'm sorry. Maybe you and Iris...
strings.아이다. 일단 봤으니 가마이 냅둘 수 없데이!: Nothing. But now that we know, we can't just leave it be!
strings.무웬, 어데 있는지 모르겠지만, 쪼매만 기다리라. 먼저 이 일부터 처리하: Muwen, wherever you are, wait just a little longer. We'll deal with this first, then come find you. Whew...
strings.아, %s. 고블린들이 활을 다룰 줄 아니까 고블린들에게 있을지도…. 후: Oh, %s. Goblins know how to use bows, so they might have it... All right, let's brace ourselves and look.
strings.그리고 아셰가 아직 신전에 있을 테니, 찾으면 찾았다고 이야기 해야 한다: And Ases should still be at the temple. If we find it, we need to let her know. Got it?
strings.(사실 궁금한 게 많지만, 일단 고블린에게서 세레스티아를 찾아내자.): (I have plenty of questions, but first I should recover Serestia from the goblins.)
strings.(고블린에게서 세레스티아가 발견됐다. 의외로 쉽게 찾은 것 같다.): (You find Serestia among the goblins. That was surprisingly easy.)
That's it! That's the one. You really are something special. Just as Iris... Oh, never mind.
strings.그러면 아세스에게 어떻게 하면 물어보면 되는 거지?: So I should ask Ases what to do next?
Exactly. And look, there's Ases over there.
strings.아, 세레스티아를 찾았군요! 다행이에요!: Oh, you found Serestia! What a relief!
strings.아셰, 세레스티아를 야휘 씨한테 맽기면 되나?: Ases, should we give Serestia back to Mr. Yahui?
Yes, Zoe, that should do it. Let's go. Oh, Ignate? You look worried. What's wrong?
We've got trouble! The enraged goblins have headed into the village.
Ugh, if those goblins have gone to the village, they'll be heading for...
strings.고블린들은 마을에서 여관만 털어요. 거기에 먹을 게 제일 많거든요. 이번: Goblins always raid the inn. That's where the most food is. This time will be no different...
Oh no, that's serious! We'd better hurry.
strings.그런데 %s, 가능하겠어요? 이제 여행을 시작한 지 얼마 안됐는데, 많은: But %s, can you handle it? You've only just started your journey. Wouldn't fighting that many monsters be too much?
She's right. It might be better to go with the soldiers from Elias...
strings.어쩌죠? 조에, 이 상황을 어떻게 했으면 좋겠어?: What should we do? Zoe, how do you think we should handle this?
strings.조에, 무슨 생각을 그리 해?: Zoe, what are you thinking about?
Nothing. Something just came to mind... Let's head to the inn first.
strings.에린, 너무 겁 먹지 마! 나도 무섭잖아!: Erin, stop panicking! You're making me scared too!
strings.에, 자세히 보니 고블린이 왕 크네? 대왕고블린이 있다는 건 들어봤는데,: Huh, that goblin really is huge up close! I've heard of King Goblins. Is that because they're king-sized, royally cute, and as commanding as a king?
strings.얘들아. 진정해. 대체 무슨 소리를 하고 있니? 저것들은 우리 가게를 습: Girls, calm down. What are you talking about? Those monsters are attacking our business.
Keber, are you all right? You were caught completely off guard...
Don't worry. It takes more than that to knock me down. I've still got some fight left in me.
strings.하지만 저 몬스터 녀석, 무슨 일인지 공격이 통하지 않는군. 무슨 마법의: But for some reason, my attacks aren't hurting that monster. Is some kind of magic protecting it...?
Zoe, stop for a moment. There are goblins inside...
strings.뭐꼬? 이거 그냥 고블린도 아이고, 대왕이가?!: What's this? Not just any goblin—a King Goblin?!
And it isn't an ordinary King Goblin, either. Something's affected it.
strings.니도 느껴지나? 고블린들한테 이상한 힘이…. 왠지 일반 공격이 안 통할: You feel it too? There's a strange power coming from them... I've got a feeling ordinary attacks won't work...
strings.(매고 있던 가방에서 갑자기 신비한 빛이 솟아오른다. 깜짝 놀라 살펴보니: (A mysterious light suddenly rises from the bag on your back. Startled, you look inside. It is coming from Serestia, the bow said to have been made by the Tyr.)
strings.자, 잠깐! 나보고 이걸 사용하라고?: W-wait! You want me to use it?
strings.시끄럽데이!! 잔말 말고 세레스티아를 장착하고 고블린을 공격하라, 마!: Stop fussing! Just equip Serestia and shoot the goblins! Got it?
strings.(어쩔 수 없네…, 그럼 해볼까?): (I don't have much choice... Here goes.)
All that trouble from those little pests... It's over now.
The owner says thank you. There wasn't much damage in the end. Good work, %s.
Oh, thanks... But this bow, Serestia...
strings.(세레스티아는 사실 이리스만 쓸 수 있는 물건이었단 말이다. 근데, 와: (Only Iris was supposed to be able to use Serestia. So why did it work in %s's hands?)
strings.(모르긴 몰라도 %s 야가 어쩌면 이리스에게….): (I can't be sure, but perhaps %s could be... for Iris...)
strings.%s, 이 활 말이다. 지 할 일 다 했다고 자는 것 같데이. 아, 야휘: %s, this bow seems to have gone to sleep now that its job's done. Oh, Mr. Yahui! You're here?
Just as you said, Miss Zoe. Serestia has stopped glowing, as though it has fallen asleep.
strings.아, 됐고. 야휘 씨, 보소. 이번에 이렇게 끝났지만, 다음에 또 이런: Right, but listen, Mr. Yahui. We settled things this time, but who's to say it won't happen again?
What if Iris comes back to the village and finds it gone? Think how upset she'd be...
strings.정말 죄송합니다. 두 번 다시 이런 실수는 하지 않겠습니다. 믿고 맡겨주: I am truly sorry. I won't make this mistake again. Please trust me to keep it safe.
Zoe, let's rest a bit, then head to Elias.
No, there's somewhere we need to go first. The [Dragon's Lair]...
Deep inside the Temple of Pluton. A very nasty dragon lives there.
strings.아마도 거 주인인 아가 몬스터들을 조종하는 것 같다 아이가. 일반 고블린: I think the one who lives there must be controlling the monsters. That was a King Goblin, after all, not an ordinary goblin...
strings.아이다. 야가 발음이 안 좋데이. 내 따라 해라. 인. 보. 크. 인보끄: No, no, your pronunciation's all wrong. Say it after me. In. Voke. Invoke!
That's the one. The master of the Dragon's Lair, a wicked red dragon hatchling...
strings.어리다꼬 내비둔 게 잘못이었던 갑따. 가서 혼을 내줘야 할 것 같다 아이: Maybe we shouldn't have let it off just because it was young. We'd better go teach it a lesson.
strings.흠, 그곳에 가지 않는다면 이런 일이 계속되겠지?: Hmm. If we don't go, this sort of thing will keep happening, won't it?
strings.(…세레스티아는 이리스의 물건인데, 왜 나한테 반응한 거지?): (...Serestia belongs to Iris. Why did it react to me?)
strings.이거 고민 되는 일이가?: Is this really such a hard decision?
Ah, nah... I mean, no. I was just thinking about something...
Having second thoughts? Worried it's dangerous? Don't worry so much. You've got me.
All right. I'm counting on you, then.
strings.그래도 혹시 모르니까 준비 좀 단단히 하고 가재이. 알았재?: Still, we'd better prepare properly, just in case. Got it?
Unequip Serestia, and Mr. Yahui will take care of it. I've told him he'll have me to answer to if he lets anything happen to it again!
Got it. I'll get ready right away. Let's go to the Dragon's Lair.
Ghk... I-I surrender. How dare you defeat me...
strings.마, 니 해냈다! 니 멋있게 싸운 거 아나? 인보끄가 기절할 정도면!: You did it! You were brilliant out there! You even knocked Invoke out!
strings.옛날에 말이다. 이리스하고 무웬이랑 싸울 때는 아주 엉망진창이었데이. 전: When Iris and Muwen fought it back in the day, it was a complete disaster. A couple of greenhorns who didn't know the first thing about fighting...
strings.니 인보크 마마인 티어메트라고 아나? 하여튼 그게 나타나가꼬 모두 죽을: You know Tiamat, Invoke's mother? She showed up and nearly killed us all. Kazno saved our lives.
strings.(어라, 인보끄가 맞을 때쯤 되면 티어메트가 나와야 되는 거 아이가. 와: (Hang on. Isn't Tiamat supposed to show up when Invoke gets beaten up? Why isn't she here? Oh, well. Better that way.)
strings.인보끄도 이제 몬스터 시켜가 마을 엉망으로 만드는 일 없을끼다. 엄써야: Invoke won't be sending monsters to wreck the village anymore. It had better not!
strings.그건 그카고, 우째, 안쪽에서 친숙한 느낌이 드는데? 잠깐 드가보까? 드: Anyway, I'm sensing something familiar farther inside. Shall we take a quick look? Come on!
strings.(두 사람이 둥지의 안쪽으로 서둘러 들어가자, 인보크가 조심스레 눈 하나: (As the two of you hurry deeper into the lair, Invoke cautiously opens one eye.)
strings.(인보크가 한숨을 내쉬며 자리에서 일어난다.): (Invoke sighs and gets to its feet.)
strings.생명에게 공포와 절망을 안겨주는 대지와 하늘의 정복자, 불꽃의 지배자,: The conqueror of earth and sky, who brings fear and despair to all living things! The ruler of flame, whose name all praise!
strings.어으…. 여기저기 쑤시네. 갑자기 쳐들어와서는 쟤네들 무슨 소리를 하는: Oww... I ache all over. They barged in out of nowhere, spouting who knows what. Ugh, so much for my dignity.
strings.앞으로 후손들에겐 꽃의 정령을 절대 건들지 말라고 해야겠어. 그런데 저: I'd better tell my descendants never to mess with a flower spirit. But what was that human?
strings.그나저나 내가 몬스터를 부려? 이리스의 활? 대체 무슨 소릴 하는거야?: And since when do I command monsters? Iris's bow? What were they even talking about?
strings.자, 잠깐…. 나 혹시 억울하게 맞은 거야?: W-wait... Did I just get beaten up for something I didn't do?
strings.(조에를 쫓아 간 둥지의 끝에 한 소년이 서 있다. 소년이 조에를 알아봤: (At the far end of the lair, you find a boy waiting. Recognizing Zoe, he greets her with a radiant smile.)
strings.(아, 조에를 잘 알고 있는 것 같은데, 조에가 말한 그 아이인가?): (Oh, he seems to know her well. Is this the boy she mentioned?)
strings.(조에 얼굴이 환해지는 걸 보니 맞는 것 같네.): (Seeing how her face lit up, I think that's him.)
strings.무웬, 니! 그동안 어데서 뭐하고 있었던 기고!?: Muwen! Where have you been, and what have you been doing all this time?!
strings.(조에가 무웬의 볼을 붙잡고 쭉 늘리고 있다.): (Zoe has grabbed Muwen's cheeks and is stretching them.)
strings.조에, 일단 그거 놓고 이야기하는 건 어때?: Zoe, how about letting go before you talk?
Oh, there I go again. Old habits. Sorry, Muwen.
strings.나는 괜찮아. 그보다 조에가 무사해서 다행이야. 다행이야~. 다행이야~: I'm all right. I'm just glad you're safe, Zoe. So glad! So glad!
strings.(무웬이 헤헤 웃으며 조에의 손을 잡더니 빙글빙글 돌기 시작한다. 조에도: (Grinning, Muwen takes Zoe's hands and starts spinning in circles. Zoe sighs and spins along, apparently used to this.)
strings.(한참을 그러다 이제야 무웬과 %s의 눈이 마주친다.): (After a while, Muwen finally makes eye contact with %s.)
strings.아! 당신이 %s!! 이야기 들었어!: Oh! You're %s! I've heard about you!
strings.어, 나를 알고 있어요?: Oh, you know who I am?
%s, no need to be so formal with the boy. You have my permission!
Yeah, Ases told me. You taught that scary King Goblin a lesson!
strings.니, 그라모 거기 거 기다리든가 해뿌지. 뭐하러 와 여까지 왔나. 위험하: Then why didn't you just stay there and wait? Why come all the way out here? It's dangerous!
Because I knew you'd come here, Zoe.
Honestly... This boy hasn't an ounce of fear.
strings.뭐, 이렇게 만났으니까 다행이야!: Well, we found each other, so it all worked out!
strings.다행은 뭐가 다행이고! 이 문디 자슥! 그동안 어데서 뭐하고 지냈나 다: Worked out, my foot! You little rascal! Tell me everything you've been doing and everywhere you've been. Understand?
strings.알았다. 걱정마…. 그런데 %s, 야가 들어도 될까?: All right, don't worry... But is it okay for %s to hear this?
strings.%s, 미안타. 내 무웬과 할 말이 있다. 잠깐 저쪽에서 이야기 좀 하고: %s, sorry. I need a word with Muwen. We'll talk over there for a moment. Wait here, will you?
strings.(이야기를 끝낸 조에와 무웬이 천천히 걸어나온다.): (Their conversation over, Zoe and Muwen walk slowly back toward you.)
strings.나도 이리스를 찾아 떠나고 싶지만, 지금은 이곳을 떠나면 안 될 것 같아: I'd like to go looking for Iris too, but I don't think I should leave this place yet.
strings.인보크 같은 단순히 위협적인 느낌이 아니야. 마왕을 만났을 때와 같은 그: It's not just the threat you feel from someone like Invoke. It's terror, like when we met the Demon King...
strings.사룡의 둥지 어데 그런 게 있는 기가?: Where in the Dragon's Lair is it coming from?
strings.%s, 이리스를 찾는다 했지?: %s, you said you were looking for Iris, right?
strings.(이야기를 다 하지도 않았는데, 조에가 치고 나온다.): (Before you can finish, Zoe cuts in.)
strings.저기, %s…. 이리스 찾는 일을 니한테 부탁해도 되겠나?: Listen, %s... Can we leave the search for Iris to you?
strings.나도 부탁해. %s. 사실 나도 이리스를 찾으러 가고 싶었는데, 지금 내: I'm asking you too, %s. I wanted to go looking for Iris myself, but I don't know how much help I'd be right now.
Don't say that, Muwen. Don't you know how much help you are?
Thanks, Zoe. Still, when it comes to finding Iris, rather than me...
strings.아무래도 %s…. %s의 여행이 이리스를 찾아줄 거란 생각이 들어서 말이: I think %s... I have a feeling your journey will lead you to Iris, %s.
I can't quite explain it, but I feel like I have to follow my own path.
We'll handle things here in our own way. Think of it as our training.
strings.그러다 보면 우리는 언젠가 다시 만나지 않을까?: And if we do that, won't we meet again someday?
strings.(무웬의 말에서 왠지 모를 믿음이 느껴진다.): (There is something quietly reassuring about Muwen's words.)
strings.그라모 엘리아스에 가면 이그나트, 용경에 가면 샤오위에게 대충 우리 안부: Then give our regards to Ignate when you reach Elias, and to Xiaowei in Yong Gyoung. Though we did see Ignate just a little while ago...
All right. I'll keep looking for Iris. See you again.
Thank you. And we'll definitely meet again someday.
Oh, gone already. I'm a little sad...
strings.무웬, 니 말이다. 이리스 찾는 거…. 아, 아이다. 아이다. 그건 나중: Muwen, about finding Iris... Ah, never mind. We'll talk about that later. Now we'd better find that thing.
Stop worrying over nothing. You'll make Iris worry too.
strings.(조에와 무웬이 밖으로 나가자 어디선가 이 광경을 보고 있던 누군가가 천: (After Zoe and Muwen leave, someone who has been watching from an unseen hiding place slowly emerges.)
strings.흥. 언제나 느낀 거지만, 저 꼬맹이는 촉이 좋다니까. 그 촉 때문에 살: Hmph. I've always thought that brat had good instincts. Perhaps they're the reason he's still alive...
strings.이 꼬맹이들이 살아있는 걸 알면 갇혀있는 녀석은 어떤 표정을 지을까?: I wonder what face our prisoner would make upon learning those brats are alive.
strings.궁금해 미치겠어. 아무것도 몰랐던 녀석이 진실을 알고 고통받던 표정은 정: I'm dying to know. The agony on that clueless fool's face when the truth finally came out... It was exquisite.
Don't look at me like that.
strings.날 그런 식으로 보지 말라고!: I said, don't look at me like that!
You can't do a thing, yet you dare look at me with such contempt.
strings.으윽, 결코 네 뜻대로는 안 될 거야. 내 머릿속에서 사라져! 사라져 버: Urgh... I won't let you have your way. Get out of my head! Get out!
This can't go on. Even that thing the old geezer spoke of... All of it...
strings.이 세계에서 지워주겠어!!: I'll erase it from this world!
strings.(잘 정리된 길을 따라 안으로 들어서니 많은 사람들의 모습이 보인다.): (You follow the well-kept road into the city and find yourself among a bustling crowd.)
strings.(고풍스러움과 세련미를 모두 간직한 도시의 느낌이 웅장하기까지 하다.): (The city blends old-world charm with sophistication, creating an air of grandeur.)
Wow. So this is what it's like here.
No use standing around. I'd better find Instructor Ignate.
You're the one who was with Miss Zoe...
strings.(조에와 무웬을 만났고, 헤어져 각자 여행을 하게 됐다고 이야기한다.): (You explain that you met up with Zoe and Muwen, then parted ways to continue your separate journeys.)
strings.그렇군. 그때처럼 다시 할 일을 찾아 떠났다면 %s…, 어디로 갈 건가?: I see. If you've set off again with something to do, just as you did then... Where are you headed, %s?
strings.그게 용경으로 가야 할 것 같아요. 조에가 용경에 아는 사람이 있다고 했: I think I should go to Yong Gyoung. Zoe said she knew someone there.
strings.용경이라…. 지금은 엘리아스 왕국의 지방 도시지만, 오래전 큰 제국의 중: Yong Gyoung... These days, it's a provincial city of the Kingdom of Elias, but long ago it was the heart of a great empire. It's a beautiful place, with plenty to see.
strings.만약 도움이 필요하다면 가는 도시에서 교관을 찾아. 모험가 협회에선 전용: If you need help, look for the instructor in the city you're visiting. We in the Adventurer Association keep in touch through our own communications network to help adventurers.
Thank you. I'll head there, then.
